# 2004 Elections

There were 6 elections held in Jersey in 2004.

- **[Senator By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2004#e5)**

  1 seat · 6 candidates · 24.7% turnout
- **[St Saviour Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2004#e29)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[Grouville Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2004#e30)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Peter Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2004#e31)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Helier Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2004#e32)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Clement Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2004#e25)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · Turnout unknown

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

## 2004 Senator By-Election

By-election following the resignation of Christopher Lakeman (1 seat), 24th March 2004.

**[Dick Shenton OBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dick-shenton) was elected as Senator**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Dick Shenton OBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dick-shenton)** |  | 7,144 | 62.2% |
| 2 | [Juliette Gallichan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/juliette-gallichan) |  | 1,715 | 14.9% |
| 3 | [Robert Weston](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robert-weston) |  | 1,284 | 11.2% |
| 4 | [Kevin Lewis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis) |  | 724 | 6.3% |
| 5 | [Robert Brown](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robert-brown) |  | 264 | 2.3% |
| 6 | [Terry Coutanche](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-coutanche) |  | 249 | 2.2% |

11,480 votes (inc. 60 spoilt papers)

46,474 registered voters

24.7% turnout

_Registered voters estimated._

## 2004 St Saviour Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Saviour](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour) (1 seat), 15th June 2004.

**[Philip Ozouf Sr](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-francis-ozouf-sr) was elected as Connétable of St Saviour in 2004 unopposed**.
